title: Poached Fish with Herb
description: A delicate and flavorful dish featuring poached fish served with a sprinkle of fresh herbs.
instructions: 1. Fill a large pot with the water and bring to a boil.
2. Reduce heat to a simmer and add the fish fillets to the pot.
3. Poach the fish for 8-10 minutes or until it flakes easily with a fork.
4. Meanwhile, chop the fresh herbs and set aside.
5. Remove the fish from the pot and serve with the chopped herbs on top.
